list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden — as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
notes: All 55 trophies are single-player and offline; there are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies. PowerPyx rates the platinum about 4/10 difficulty and roughly 200 hours. The only potentially missable trophy is Positive Mental Attitude. An older datamine leak called the platinum 'Vice City Legend'; the published list names it 'Vice Got a Price!'.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically. It is the last trophy by definition, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap, not a task of its own. Expect around 200 hours in total, with the 100% completion gold (A Long Road) as the longest single requirement.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, at the start of Chapter 1. It is story-locked and unmissable: follow the on-screen objectives until the mission ends and the trophy pops. No side preparation is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) and make a manual save at the start of the chapter, because GTA 6 has no mission replay.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. This is the chapter where Jason and Lucia become playable together, which opens most partner activities and trophies that need both of them. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter, since there is no mission replay if you later want to revisit a mission-specific moment.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter and another one before the final mission, so nothing story-related is locked away after the credits.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission after Chapter 4. It is unmissable as long as you finish the story, but save manually just before it: after the credits the game continues in free roam, and a pre-finale save is the only way back to that point without replaying the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. It is unmissable if you play through the main missions; just follow the mission markers to the end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks through normal story progress, so keep playing the main missions and it will come up on its own.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named mission trophies, it is part of the main story path and cannot be skipped while playing through the chapters.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the story missions in order; the trophy pops when the mission's final objective is done.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It is a story mission, so it arrives through normal chapter progress.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the main missions in order and this trophy comes with the story, like the other named mission trophies.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion). The checklist has 35 tasks covering story, strangers, activities and collectibles; progress made before the story ends still counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. Do it last, after the story and side missions, and use the checklist itself as your remaining-work list. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy in the set.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform 250 stunts in total: jumps, near misses, long airtime and similar driving feats all add up across the whole game, so this is a long grind rather than a single trick. It builds naturally while you drive everywhere for other trophies; chase ramps and jumps deliberately in free roam to finish it off. Track the count in the Progress menu.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, other races, arcade games, bowling and the rest of the leisure activities around Leonida. You only need one attempt at each, not a win, so sample everything early and this pops quickly.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the ranges; each needs its gold score, so practise the weapon types you are weakest at and replay challenges until every one shows gold. This is one of the six silver trophies and one of the more skill-heavy ones.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race, so you must win at every one of them, not just win 14 races anywhere. Learn each course's corners, then clear the locations one by one.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different matters: winning the same race 20 times does not count. Work through the race list across Leonida — street races, off-road and any other race type — and keep a note of which ones you have already won.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activities around Leonida; take the challenge against Cal and out-fish him. If you lose, you can retry the challenge, so keep at it until you win.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade in Leonida. Any arcade game counts, and you only need to finish one, so pick the shortest or easiest game you find and play it through to the end.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's side-character mission chain. Side characters give a series of missions across the story; keep accepting Andy's missions when they appear until the chain ends with its final mission.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's side-character mission chain. Work through Kenton's missions as they unlock during the story until the last one is done.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's side-character mission chain. Billy's missions appear as you progress; finish the whole chain and the trophy pops with its last mission.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question-mark encounters on the map; each strand is a small chain of missions. There are more than 8 strands in the state, so you can pick the ones you find first and skip the rest.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's side-character mission chain. Follow Randy's missions through the story until the chain closes with its final mission.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's side-character mission chain. Keep taking Tyrone's missions as they appear and finish the chain; the trophy comes with the last one.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, according to PowerPyx and GTABase. THIS IS THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony of Jason's house — follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation disappears forever after Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter. Whether the balcony meditation is strictly required is still unconfirmed, so do it to be safe. For the other spots, meditation icons show purple when you are close; meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each outdoor spot, since each character counts separately toward the 18. Note: sources disagree on the count — GTABase says 18 spots, while the 100% completion checklist asks for 15 of 18 — so follow the 18-spot target for this trophy and track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand sends you after one specific animal; follow his missions, track the animal, and take it down as instructed. It is part of a side chain, so it stays available in free roam after the story.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered around Leonida; each set needs every card in it, so collect methodically area by area and check your collection progress to see which sets are nearly done. The exact location of every card is still being mapped by guide sites at launch, so use a card map from PowerPyx or GTABase once published rather than guessing — this guide does not invent locations.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK It is the in-game photo-sharing action; open it at landmarks, viewpoints and distinct spots as you explore, and the count grows with each new location. It pairs well with exploring all 52 areas for The Goodtime State.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small optional objectives spread across activities and free roam; they accumulate as you play, so keep an eye on the challenge list in the Progress menu and clear the easy ones first. You need 50 of them, not all of them.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner (Jason or Lucia) beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the police and escape. Both characters must be together when the heat drops. Do it in a fast car with a clear escape route: break line of sight, hide until the wanted stars fade, and keep your partner with you the whole time.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without ever losing your wanted level between them — the wanted level must stay active across all three robberies. Plan a route of three close-together shops, rob each in turn, and keep moving; if the wanted level drops to zero, the streak resets and you start again.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting in a new vehicle type for the first time counts toward the total, so drive everything you see — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft — and vary where you look: city streets, the countryside, the airport and the docks each hide different vehicles.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus (the slow-motion aiming mode). Find a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before the effect ends. A busy shootout or a gang hideout is the easiest place to line this up.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport): get into a plane at the airport and take off without a scheduled flight. Steal a plane on the tarmac and get airborne; the trophy is about leaving on your own terms, not about flying to a destination.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank — the description's joke is the clue. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and around military areas; steal one or climb into one when you find it, and the trophy should pop once you are driving it. Expect heavy police attention while you do it.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid the cameras and guards, take the goods, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection is what fails it, not the robbery itself.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault robbery needs a getaway: crack the vault, grab the cash, then lose the police before the robbery counts. Plan your escape car and route before you go in, and repeat at five different vaults.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; stop one, break it open, take the cash, then lose the wanted level. One successful robbery and getaway is all it takes.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited, so drive or fly through every named region — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the countryside and the small towns — until the area counter reads 52 of 52. Check the map for areas you have never entered.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal Operations are gang-run sites marked around Leonida; hit one site per gang, not nine sites of the same gang. Note which gang each site belongs to before you rob it, so you can tick gangs off one by one.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or vendor on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and drink it while looking out at the sea. It is a small flavour moment, not a mission — just be at the right place and take the drink.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom's front window and out onto the street. Pick a showroom, build speed inside or outside, and crash through the glass — the trophy is a nod to the classic GTA showroom escape.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a game with a proper follow-through. Go to the alley, start a bowling game, and play it through; the trophy is tied to finishing the game at that specific alley, not to your score.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership moment with mass appeal — a social-media-flavoured trophy tied to Jason and Lucia doing something together that gets attention in-game. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by guide sites at launch (the official description is deliberately vague), so check PowerPyx's guide for the confirmed method rather than guessing; this entry will not invent a step. Sources: PowerPyx, Kengamer.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices in the game — the trophy tracks decisions you make during missions and side content (the PSN tracker counts up to 500 choice events). Just play through the story and side missions making choices when offered; it accumulates on its own and is not tied to one single decision.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try: fail an activity or challenge once, then pass it on the very next attempt. Pick an easy repeatable activity, fail it deliberately, then succeed immediately after — the trophy is about the second attempt landing, not about the activity itself.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — a hidden oddity or easter-egg event. The official description is vague on purpose, and the exact trigger is still being confirmed by guide sites at launch; check PowerPyx's guide for the confirmed location rather than wandering blind. This entry does not invent a location for it.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: while driving past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle and bowl them over. Get up some speed, line up a pedestrian on the roadside, and time the swing as you pass. It is a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your laundering contacts and convert them to clean cash. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so keep laundering after every big score until the $250,000 total is reached.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. The total is cumulative: clothes, weapons, food, car mods and anything else bought in a shop all count. It builds naturally over a full playthrough; if you are short near the end, buy expensive weapons or vehicle upgrades to close the gap.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought through the in-game property listings; they unlock as you progress and earn money. Buy each one as it becomes available — the trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lets you register vehicles you own or find; open it, register a vehicle, and repeat with 10 different vehicles. Any 10 vehicles count, so use the cheapest or most common ones you already have.

sources.name: Kengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
